meta.label: Deep learning on images
meta.description:
Use a pre-trained model to score images or extract features. You can retrain generic models to specialize them on a particular set of images. 
⚠️ This plugin is now partially superseded by the native [image classification capabilities](https://doc.dataiku.com/dss/latest/machine-learning/computer-vision/index.html).
meta.author: Dataiku
